assumptions.B2: known affected link, one unrestricted constant bias
assumptions.B3: known affected link AND injection amplitude; ideal oracle only

coverage.interpretation: pointwise ellipses; six-epoch all coverage is separately empirical; no protection level

information.covariance: unscaled known-noise Gauss-Newton inverse only when full rank and finite; else null; no ridge

noise.sharing: same seed uses same standard-normal arrays across ALL conditions; all methods share one observation object

priors.center: geometry.survey; variant delta does not change initialization

statistics.aggregate: per condition and method; do not pool conditions or cars as independent seeds
statistics.interval: pointwise percentile of paired seed means, valid subset explicitly conditional; no multiplicity guarantee
statistics.missing_policy: null, never zero; retain all planned denominators; no superiority claim from success subset
statistics.position_metric: per-car mean squared 2D error over six epochs; per-seed RMSE=sqrt(MSE)

linear_sanity.interpretation: exploratory diagnostic flags, no tuning; per-condition mean/variance checks preserve correlated coordinates; analytic per-input gates are mandatory
